prompt_shape.target: <think> short reasoning </think> + rule quote + one-line conclusion + Answer: X

fallback_reasons: no rules index at data/processed/corpus_index.npz (build it on the Mac with scripts/build_rules_index.py)
preload_search.note: search_rules falls back to lexical BM25 when no usable rules index exists, as the scorer does; a build where data/processed/corpus_index.npz is usable would record 'hybrid' here

leak_guard.method: normalised words (lowercase, brackets and punctuation removed); fails on a shared word 8-gram between an item's statement or target and any gold question or choice, or a difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio >= 0.8 between an item's statement and any gold question, both as lists of normalised words
